_comment: The Ship Designer's pickers (wire ids 54-56). hd_extension: The help popup auto-sizes to its text and scrolls when it cannot fit. The original draws a fixed box and lets FMTPARA wrap into it at a fixed 339 px (TEXTBOX::Draw_Help_Entry_, textbox.cpp:307); at four HD resolutions a fixed box either wastes half the screen on two lines or clips a long entry. Marked once per file, here, and in core/helppopup.py. No region here uses it yet (OMISSION picker_help).
